meta.name: get-qodo-rules
meta.description: Loads org- and repo-level coding rules from Qodo before code tasks begin, ensuring all generation and modification follows team standards. Use before any code generation or modification task when rules are not already loaded. Invoke when user asks to write, edit, refactor, or review code, or when starting implementation planning.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 加载团队编码规则，确保代码符合规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队有编码规则需要自动遵守
copy.tagline_en: Load team coding rules to ensure code compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team has coding rules to enforce automatically

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在代码任务前检查 Qodo 规则是否已加载;若没有,就从 Qodo 平台拉取当前仓库与组织的编码规则,按 ERROR、WARNING、RECOMMENDATION 分级展示并执行,最后汇报哪些规则被应用。
howto.when: 当你要求写、改或重构代码等任务,或开始实现规划时触发;若对话中已有“Qodo Rules Loaded”则跳过。

say.text: 先加载 Qodo 规则再开始写代码
say.note: Claude 会先获取规则再生成代码。

say.text: 获取当前仓库的 Qodo 编码规则
say.note: Claude 会拉取并展示规则。

say.text: 按 Qodo 规则检查我刚才的改动
say.note: Claude 会对照规则给出分级结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude checks whether Qodo rules are already loaded before code tasks; if not, it fetches coding rules for the current repo and org from Qodo, displays them by severity (ERROR, WARNING, RECOMMENDATION), follows them, then reports which were applied.
howto.when_en: When you ask to write, edit, or refactor code, or start implementation planning; skipped if 'Qodo Rules Loaded' is already in context.

say_en.text: Load Qodo rules before writing code
say_en.note: Claude fetches rules then generates code.

say_en.text: Fetch current repo's Qodo coding rules
Check my recent changes against Qodo rules
say_en.note: Claude compares and reports by severity.
